verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a Warehouse Sync API (mparticle-docs-18, mparticle-docs-x4) that can programmatically configure warehouse ingestion, which is a source-side pipeline. A Platform API path exists for audiences (mparticle-docs-19). Wiring an audience to an output, however, is documented only as a UI flow under Setup > Directory (mparticle-docs-x2), so destinations and stream connections have no programmatic evidence. missing for 10: documented API endpoints to create general inputs and outputs and wire connections, delivery/forwarding inspection via API, an MCP server or agent-oriented tooling, and hands-on corroboration.
